group_assessment.weighting: A paediatric department reporting one child with a commercial exome; the attribution of the phenotype to WWOX is asserted, not tested, and the literature table carries transcription errors. Not a per-author sweep.

entries.proposition: The child had no early seizure disorder; an affected sibling with seizures was not genotyped.
entries.snippet: our patient presented with a global developmental delay and no early seizure disorder despite a family history of seizures and cerebral palsy in his brother and cousin, respectively

entries.proposition: MRI was normal, no microcephaly, no optic atrophy.
entries.snippet: Additionally, the MRI was normal, with no progressive microcephaly or bilateral optic atrophy.

entries.proposition: At 21 months the child walks, runs and says ten words.
entries.snippet: Currently, at the age of 21 months, he can say 10 words but not complete sentences, climb stairs with assistance, walk, and run with recurrent falling.

entries.proposition: The splice effect is an in silico prediction only.
